_what: What the Media section's one suggestion is made of, as DATA (src/media-next-edit.mjs reads it). A destination qualifies when its capabilities include one of `destination_capabilities`; `format_rules` are tried in order and the first whose capability the destination has names the format. With no destination connected, `default_format` is used. Each format names the recording lengths that fit it. `clips_per_pick` recordings make one suggestion; `sets` suggestions are ranked ahead so Another is instant. The suggestion draws on the newest `candidate_window` playable, unused recordings, read at most `candidate_pages` library pages deep, never the whole library. `score_candidates` recordings (best by words, length and recency) are scored against the pursuit the format serves; `candidate_characters` bounds each one's text. `weights` blend the four measures; the pursuit weight is shared out among the others when no pursuit is recorded or scoring fails. `recency_half_life_days` halves a recording's recency every that many days. `words_for_full_score` words said count as fully speaking. `said` is the result kind and path whose text a recording is scored by.

questions.pursuit: Which pursuit does publishing this move forward?
questions.clip: Which recording moves this pursuit forward most?

tool_said._what: What tool:suggest-next-edit says about the suggestion in one sentence, by its state (person-store accountActions).
tool_said.ready: Your next edit is ready: three clips and why.
tool_said.not-now: You set the next edit aside for today.
tool_said.nothing-unused: Every recording you have is already in an edit.
